headline: Ministry-hosted report says Hubei issued an AI transport action plan with 2028 targets
summary: A Ministry of Transport-hosted China Transportation News report dated October 29 says Hubei's transport department recently issued an AI-plus-transport action plan. The report attributes to it 2028 targets for 20 or more sector datasets, 20 or more AI application scenarios and exploration of 50 data-service products, with intended work across roads, ports, logistics, travel and regulation. The issuing plan itself was not inspected; these are reported targets, not evidence of implementation, spending or benefit.
